extension.summary: Access your content from Easynews and Debrid Clouds.
extension.description: This add-on is intended for advanced Kodi users only. You must own the content of any media you play through this addon. This is an English language only add-on.
extension.disclaimer: The author of this addon does not host any of the content which is found and has no affiliation with any of the content providers.
extension.news:
[B]Private Fen Light build 2.2.05.4 by Tinkerer[/B] - New private profiles now default to the paired CocoScrapers module. - Deferred Fen's self-restart after metadata changes until the next Kodi launch to avoid service shutdown stalls. - Added shutdown checks before custom skin preparation and Trakt network work. - Corrected external-cache reads and expiry deletion. - Hardened background workers, playback abort handling, dialogs, and Kodi shutdown. - Disabled the retired upstream updater; use KodiPortable Install.bat for updates. - Kept Kodi's reusable language invoker enabled for playback stability. - Paired CocoScrapers 1.0.32.2 with English stream filtering and updated providers. - Restored Bitsearch, EZTV, TorrentQuest, Rutor, and ShowRSS as enabled providers. - Premiumize selection, resolution, and API behavior were not changed.
See Changelog in Tools for the complete private-build details.
